import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, time, pickle
from scipy.optimize import minimize
exec(open('work/fitmodel.py').read().split("if __name__")[0])

def fit_annual(cols, ridge=1e-4, tag=''):
    """T2: annual matrix = single matrix at the year's mean macro (no within-year product)."""
    Fq = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]
    Y = 20
    Fa = Fq.reshape(Y,4,-1).mean(axis=1)      # (Y,k) annual mean features
    Qa = np.arange(Y).reshape(Y,1)
    k=Fa.shape[1]; ft=Fitter(k,Fa,ridge,0.0); m=ft.m
    p0=init_params(k)
    maskA={'free':np.zeros(m.n_par,bool)}; maskA['free'][k:k+7]=True; maskA['free'][k+14:k+63]=True
    maskB={'free':np.zeros(m.n_par,bool)}; maskB['free'][:k]=True; maskB['free'][k+7:k+14]=True; maskB['free'][k+63:]=True
    maskC={'free':np.ones(m.n_par,bool)}
    def run(p0, mask, F, Qm, name):
        f, idx = ft.make_obj(mask, p0.copy(), F=F, Qm=Qm)
        t0=time.time()
        r=minimize(f,p0[idx],method='L-BFGS-B',jac=True,options=dict(maxiter=20000,maxfun=400000,ftol=1e-16,gtol=1e-14))
        p=p0.copy(); p[idx]=r.x
        v=p[:k]; n=np.linalg.norm(v); p[:k]= v/n if n>1e-12 else np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k)
        val,g,ll,dev,aux=m.nll_and_grad(p,F,Qm,counts,0.0,0.0)
        print(f'  {tag} stage{name}: dev={dev:8.1f} ok={r.success} nit={r.nit} t={time.time()-t0:.0f}s',flush=True)
        return p,dev
    p0,_=run(p0,maskA,Fa,Qa,'A'); p0,_=run(p0,maskB,Fa,Qa,'B'); p0,dev=run(p0,maskC,Fa,Qa,'C')
    theta,a,c,alpha,delta,lam = m.unpack(p0)
    print(f'  {tag} theta={np.round(theta,3)} c={np.round(c,3)} delta={np.round(delta,3)} lam={np.round(lam,3)}',flush=True)
    return dict(p=p0, dev=dev, theta=theta,a=a,c=c,alpha=alpha,delta=delta,lam=lam, cols=cols, F=Fa, m=m, annual=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    res=pickle.load(open('work/fitres.pkl','rb'))
    for key,cols in [('vix',['vix']),('vix_gdp',['vix','gdp_g'])]:
        res['ANN_'+key]=fit_annual(cols, tag='ANN_'+key)
    pickle.dump(res, open('work/fitres.pkl','wb'))

exec(open('work/fitmodel.py').read().split("if __name__")[0])

def fit_generic(cols, structure, ridge=1e-4, held=None, maxiter=20000):
    """structure: 'q' (quarterly product) or 'a' (annual). held: year index to exclude."""
    Fq = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]

    cnt = counts.copy()

    else:
        Fa=Fq; Qm=Q; F=Fq
    k=F.shape[1]; ft=Fitter(k,F,ridge,0.0); m=ft.m
    p0=init_params(k)
    maskA={'free':np.zeros(m.n_par,bool)}; maskA['free'][k:k+7]=True; maskA['free'][k+14:k+63]=True
    maskB={'free':np.zeros(m.n_par,bool)}; maskB['free'][:k]=True; maskB['free'][k+7:k+14]=True; maskB['free'][k+63:]=True
    maskC={'free':np.ones(m.n_par,bool)}
    F0=np.zeros((len(F),k))

import sys, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.special import logit, expit
sys.path.insert(0,'work')
from features import load, panel, zscores, RAT, DEST, IDX, STATES
from full_model import Model, NGR, K

tr, mh, sc, pol = load()
P = panel(mh, sc); Z, stats = zscores(P); h = Z['hist']
counts = np.zeros((20,7,8))
for _, r in tr.iterrows():
    y=int(r.year)-1; i=IDX[r.from_rating]
    for j,d in enumerate(DEST): counts[y,i,j]=r[d]
TOT = counts.sum()
ORI = {'unemployment':+1,'bbb_spread':+1,'vix':+1,'gdp_g':-1,'cpi_g':+1,'hpi_g':+1,'sp_g':-1,'nas_g':-1,'djia_g':-1}
COLS = ['vix','gdp_g','unemployment','bbb_spread','cpi_g','hpi_g','sp_g','nas_g','djia_g']
Fh = np.column_stack([h[c].values*ORI[c] for c in COLS])

tr2 = tr.copy(); tr2['n'] = tr2[DEST].sum(axis=1)
START = tr2.groupby(['year','from_rating'])['n'].sum().unstack().loc[:,RAT].values   # (20,7)
END = tr2.groupby('year')[DEST].sum().loc[:,DEST].values                             # (20,8)

def init_params(k):
    den = tr[DEST].sum(axis=1)
    Pr = tr.copy(); Pr[DEST] = Pr[DEST].div(den, axis=0)
    M = np.zeros((7,8))
    for y in range(20):
        sub = Pr[Pr.year==y+1].set_index('from_rating').loc[RAT][DEST].values
        w = tr[tr.year==y+1].groupby('from_rating')[DEST].sum().sum(axis=1).loc[RAT].values
        w = w/w.sum(); M += w[:,None]*sub
    pDq = 1-(1-np.clip(M[:,7],1e-12,1-1e-12))**0.25
    a = logit(np.clip(pDq,1e-14,1-1e-14))
    G = M[:,:7]/np.clip(M[:,:7].sum(1,keepdims=True),1e-12,None)
    Gq = G/4.0; np.fill_diagonal(Gq,0.0)
    for i in range(7): Gq[i,i] = 1-Gq[i].sum()
    alpha = np.log(np.clip(Gq,1e-12,None)); alpha -= alpha.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    m = Model(k); p0 = np.zeros(m.n_par)
    p0[:k] = np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k)
    p0[k:k+7]=a; p0[k+7:k+14]=1.0; p0[k+14:k+63]=alpha.ravel()
    p0[k+63:k+70]=0.5; p0[k+70:]=0.0
    return p0

class Fitter:
    def __init__(self, k, F, ridge=1e-4, ridge_th=0.0):
        self.k=k; self.F=F; self.m=Model(k); self.ridge=ridge; self.ridge_th=ridge_th
    def obj(self, mask, p_base, F=None, Qm=None, cnt=None):
        F = self.F if F is None else F
        Qm = Q if Qm is None else Qm
        cnt = counts if cnt is None else cnt
        m=self.m; k=self.k
        idx = np.where(mask)[0]
        def f(pv):
            p = p_base.copy(); p[idx]=pv
            v=p[:k]; nrm=np.linalg.norm(v)
            theta = v/nrm if nrm>1e-12 else np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k)
            p[:k]=theta
            val,g,ll,dev,aux = m.nll_and_grad(p,F,Qm,cnt,self.ridge,self.ridge_th)
            gv = g[:k].copy()
            if nrm>1e-12: gv = (np.eye(k)-np.outer(theta,theta)) @ g[:k] / nrm
            gg=g.copy(); gg[:k]=gv
            return val/TOT, gg[idx]/TOT
        return f, idx

def fit(cols, structure='q', ridge=1e-4, ridge_th=0.0, held=None, maxiter=20000, tag='', verbose=True):
    Fq = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]
    Y=20
    cnt = counts.copy()
    if held is not None: cnt[held]=0
    if structure=='a':

    maskB={'free':np.zeros(m.n_par,bool)}; maskB['free'][:k]=True; maskB['free'][k+7:k+14]=True; maskB['free'][k+63:]=True

        p=p0.copy(); p[idx]=r.x

def annual_matrices(p, F, Qm, m):
    theta,a,c,alpha,delta,lam = m.unpack(p)
    z=F@theta; mats,pD,G = m.mats(z,a,c,alpha,delta,lam)
    Ps=mats[Qm]; nq=Qm.shape[1]; Y=Ps.shape[0]
    L=np.empty((Y,nq,8,8)); L[:,0]=np.eye(8)
    for q in range(1,nq): L[:,q]=L[:,q-1]@Ps[:,q-1]
    M=np.stack([L[:,nq-1][y]@Ps[y,nq-1] for y in range(Y)])
    return M, z

def quarterly_matrices(p, F, m):
    theta,a,c,alpha,delta,lam = m.unpack(p)
    z=F@theta; mats,pD,G = m.mats(z,a,c,alpha,delta,lam)
    return mats, z

def dev_year(M, y):
    C=counts[y]; obs=C/C.sum(axis=1)[:,None]
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
        c=np.where(C>0, C*np.log(np.clip(obs,1e-14,1)/np.clip(M[y,:7,:],1e-14,1)),0.0)
    return 2*c.sum()

def validate_history(R):
    """project each year's starting portfolio 4 quarters with the model; compare to observed year end"""
    p=R['p']; m=R['m']
    if R['structure']=='q':
        mats,z = quarterly_matrices(p, R['F'], m)
        ks=[];de=[]
        for y in range(20):
            v=np.zeros(8); v[:7]=START[y]/START[y].sum()
            for q in range(4): v = v@mats[4*y+q]
            obs=END[y]/END[y].sum()
            ks.append(np.max(np.abs(np.cumsum(v[:7])-np.cumsum(obs[:7])))); de.append(v[7]-obs[7])
        return np.array(ks), np.array(de)
    else:
        M,z = annual_matrices(p,R['F'],R['Qm'],m)
        ks=[];de=[]
        for y in range(20):
            v=np.zeros(8); v[:7]=START[y]/START[y].sum()

            obs=END[y]/END[y].sum()
            ks.append(np.max(np.abs(np.cumsum(v[:7])-np.cumsum(obs[:7])))); de.append(v[7]-obs[7])
        return np.array(ks), np.array(de)

def project(R, cohort, scen):
    """returns trajectory list of 10 vectors (8 states) for the scenario"""
    p=R['p']; m=R['m']
    if R['structure']=='q':
        Fq = np.column_stack([Z[scen][cc].values*ORI[cc] for cc in R['cols']])
        mats,z = quarterly_matrices(p, Fq, m)
        seq = [mats[i] for i in range(9)]
    else:
        # annual-level model: derive quarterly matrices via generator root at each quarter's macro
        Fq = np.column_stack([Z[scen][cc].values*ORI[cc] for cc in R['cols']])
        theta,a,c,alpha,delta,lam = m.unpack(p)
        z=Fq@theta
        seq=[]
        for t in range(9):
            Mm,_,_,_ = m.mats(np.array([z[t]]),a,c,alpha,delta,lam)
            seq.append(generator_root(Mm[0]))
    v=cohort.copy(); traj=[v.copy()]
    for t in range(9):
        v=v@seq[t]; traj.append(v.copy())
    return traj, z, seq

def generator_root(M):
    """quarterly matrix = expm(logm(M)/4) (continuous-time embedding of an annual matrix)"""
    from scipy.linalg import logm, expm
    L = logm(M)
    L = np.real_if_close(L).real
    return expm(L/4.0)

"""Generate predictions.csv, matrices.csv, backtest.csv from ONE estimated model."""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import core
from core import *
from features import RAT, DEST, STATES

def build(spec):
    """spec: dict(structure, cols, ridge) -> fitted model + outputs"""
    R = fit(spec['cols'], structure=spec['structure'], ridge=spec.get('ridge',1e-4), verbose=True)
    return R

def main(spec):
    R = build(spec)
    m = R['m']; p = R['p']
    # ---------- cohort ----------
    port = pd.read_csv('data/portfolio.csv')
    v0 = np.zeros(8)
    for _, r in port.iterrows(): v0[IDX[r.rating]] += r.obligors
    v0 = v0/v0.sum()
    # ---------- projections ----------
    pred_rows=[]; mat_rows=[]
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        traj, z, seq = project(R, v0, scen)
        for q in [4,9]:
            v = traj[q]
            for s, val in zip(STATES, v):
                pred_rows.append(dict(scenario=scen, quarter=q, state=s, share=float(val)))
        for t in range(9):
            Mq = seq[t]
            for i,r in enumerate(RAT):
                row = dict(scenario=scen, quarter=t+1, from_rating=r)
                for j,d in enumerate(DEST):
                    row[d] = float(Mq[i,j])
                mat_rows.append(row)
    # ---------- backtest ----------
    M, _ = annual_matrices(p, R['F'], R['Qm'], m)
    bt_rows=[]
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        for y in range(20):
            w = START[y]/START[y].sum()
            rate = float(w @ M[y][:,:7].sum(axis=0)[7]*0)  # placeholder
            rate = float(np.dot(START[y], M[y][:,7])/START[y].sum())
            bt_rows.append(dict(scenario=scen, year=y+1, default_rate=rate))
    pred = pd.DataFrame(pred_rows); mats = pd.DataFrame(mat_rows); bt = pd.DataFrame(bt_rows)
    pred.to_csv('predictions.csv', index=False)
    mats.to_csv('matrices.csv', index=False)
    bt.to_csv('backtest.csv', index=False)
    print('predictions rows', len(pred), 'sums ok', np.allclose(pred.groupby(['scenario','quarter']).share.sum().values,1))
    print('matrices rows', len(mats), 'row sums ok', np.allclose(mats[DEST].sum(axis=1).values,1))
    print('backtest rows', len(bt))
    return R, pred, mats, bt

if __name__=='__main__':
    spec = dict(structure='q', cols=['vix','gdp_g'], ridge=1e-4)
    R,pred,mats,bt = main(spec)
    print(pred.head(10).to_string())
    print(bt.head(5).to_string())
EOF

"""LOO-CV for the default-hazard model: T1 (quarterly product) vs T2 (annual level)."""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.special import expit
import core
from core import *
from features import RAT

cnt = counts[:,:,:7].sum(axis=2)      # (20,7) default counts
tot = counts.sum(axis=2)               # (20,7)

def build_index(cols, structure):
    F = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]
    if structure=='a': return F.reshape(20,4,-1).mean(axis=1)
    return F

def fit_def(cols, structure, held=None, k=None):
    F = build_index(cols, structure)
    if structure=='a': Zq = F.reshape(20,1,-1)
    else: Zq = F.reshape(20,4,-1)
    k = F.shape[1]
    def unpack(p):
        th=p[:k]/max(np.linalg.norm(p[:k]),1e-12); a=p[k:k+7]; c=p[k+7:k+14]
        return th,a,c
    def nll(p):
        th,a,c = unpack(p)
        z = (F@th)
        pq = expit(a[None,:]+c[None,:]*(z.reshape(20,4,1) if structure=='q' else z.reshape(20,1,1)))
        P = 1-np.prod(1-pq,axis=1)
        m = np.ones(20,bool); m[held]=False
        ll = np.sum(cnt[m]*np.log(np.clip(P[m],1e-15,1))+(tot[m]-cnt[m])*np.log(np.clip(1-P[m],1e-15,1)))
        return -ll
    p0 = np.concatenate([np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k), np.full(7,-9.), np.full(7,1.)])
    r = minimize(nll, p0, method='Nelder-Mead', options=dict(maxiter=20000, maxfev=20000, xatol=1e-10, fatol=1e-12))
    th,a,c = unpack(r.x)
    z = F@th
    pq = expit(a[None,:]+c[None,:]*(z.reshape(20,4,1) if structure=='q' else z.reshape(20,1,1)))
    return 1-np.prod(1-pq,axis=1), r

def dev_binom(k_,n_,p):
    p=np.clip(p,1e-15,1-1e-15)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
        t1=np.where(k_>0,k_*np.log(k_/n_/p),0.0); t2=np.where(n_-k_>0,(n_-k_)*np.log((n_-k_)/n_/(1-p)),0.0)
    return 2*np.sum(t1+t2)

for cols in [['vix'],['vix','gdp_g']]:
    for structure in ['a','q']:
        tot_dev=0; devs=[]
        for y in range(20):
            P,_ = fit_def(cols, structure, held=y)
            d = dev_binom(cnt[y], tot[y], P[y]); devs.append(d); tot_dev+=d
        print(f'DEF LOO struct={structure} cols={cols}: total dev={tot_dev:.1f}', flush=True)
        print('   per-year', np.round(devs,1), flush=True)
EOF

"""LOO-CV for the default-hazard model (normalised index), T1 vs T2."""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.special import expit
import core
from core import *

cnt = counts[:,:,:7].sum(axis=2); tot = counts.sum(axis=2)

def run(cols, structure, held):
    F = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]
    k=F.shape[1]
    zq = F if structure=='q' else F.reshape(20,4,-1).mean(axis=1)
    Z3 = zq.reshape(20,4,k) if structure=='q' else zq.reshape(20,1,k)
    def unpack(p):
        v=p[:k]; n=np.linalg.norm(v); th = v/n if n>1e-12 else np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k)
        return th, p[k:k+7], p[k+7:k+14]
    def nll(p):
        th,a,c = unpack(p)
        z = (zq@th)
        pq = expit(a[None,:]+c[None,:]*(z.reshape(20,4,1) if structure=='q' else z.reshape(20,1,1)))
        P = 1-np.prod(1-pq,axis=1)
        m=np.ones(20,bool); m[held]=False
        return -np.sum(cnt[m]*np.log(np.clip(P[m],1e-15,1))+(tot[m]-cnt[m])*np.log(np.clip(1-P[m],1e-15,1)))
    best=None
    for c0 in [0.5,1.0,2.0]:
        p0 = np.concatenate([np.ones(k)/np.sqrt(k), np.full(7,-9.), np.full(7,c0)])
        r = minimize(nll,p0,method='L-BFGS-B',options=dict(maxiter=5000,maxfun=100000,ftol=1e-16,gtol=1e-12))
        if best is None or r.fun<best.fun: best=r
    th,a,c = unpack(best.x)
    z = zq@th
    pq = expit(a[None,:]+c[None,:]*(z.reshape(20,4,1) if structure=='q' else z.reshape(20,1,1)))
    return 1-np.prod(1-pq,axis=1)

def dev_binom(k_,n_,p):
    p=np.clip(p,1e-15,1-1e-15)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
        t1=np.where(k_>0,k_*np.log(k_/n_/p),0.0); t2=np.where(n_-k_>0,(n_-k_)*np.log((n_-k_)/n_/(1-p)),0.0)
    return 2*np.sum(t1+t2)

if __name__=='__main__':
    for structure in ['q','a']:
        for cols in [['vix'],['vix','gdp_g'],['vix','gdp_g','unemployment']]:
            tot_dev=0; devs=[]
            for y in range(20):
                P = run(cols, structure, y)
                d = dev_binom(cnt[y], tot[y], P[y]); devs.append(d); tot_dev+=d
            print(f'DEF LOO struct={structure} cols={cols}: total={tot_dev:.1f}', flush=True)
            print('   per-year', np.round(devs,1), flush=True)
EOF

def zscores(P, cols=RAW):
    """standardise each scenario block using history mean/sd; missing -> 0."""
    h = P['hist']
    stats = {}
    for c in cols:
        mu, sd = h[c].astype(float).mean(), h[c].astype(float).std()
        if not np.isfinite(sd) or sd==0: sd=1.0
        stats[c]=(float(mu),float(sd))

        for c in cols:

            z[c] = ((g[c].astype(float)-mu)/sd).fillna(0.0)
        out[k]=z
    return out, stats

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.special import expit, logit
import core
from core import *
from features import panel, zscores
P = panel(core.mh, core.sc); Z2, st2 = zscores(P); core.Z = Z2

cnt = counts[:,:,:7].sum(axis=2); tot = counts.sum(axis=2)
def dev_binom(k_,n_,p):
    p=np.clip(p,1e-15,1-1e-15)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
        t1=np.where(k_>0,k_*np.log(k_/n_/p),0.0); t2=np.where(n_-k_>0,(n_-k_)*np.log((n_-k_)/n_/(1-p)),0.0)
    return 2*np.sum(t1+t2)

cols=['vix','gdp_g']
F = Fh[:, [COLS.index(c) for c in cols]]
zann = F.reshape(20,4,-1).mean(axis=1)

    res[struct]=M

        r=minimize(nll,[-1.0,1.0],method='L-BFGS-B')
        pred[:,i]=expit(r.x[0]+r.x[1]*zann)
    return pred

print('CCC/C observed vs predicted:')
for name, Pm in [('obs',None),('simple',ps),('T1',res['q'][:,:7,7]),('T2',res['a'][:,:7,7])]:

    else: v=Pm[:,6]

"""Generate predictions.csv, matrices.csv, backtest.csv from ONE estimated model.

Model (estimated once on the 20-year history):
  * macro index  z_q = theta' f_q  (f = standardised quarterly macro features)
  * quarterly transition matrix for origin rating i:
        p_D(i,q) = logistic(a_i + c_i z_q)
        P(j|i,q) = (1-p_D) * softmax_j( alpha_ij + [delta_i (pos_i-pos_j) + lambda_i] z_q )
  * the annual transition matrix of year y is the product of that year's four
    quarterly matrices (D absorbing).
The three scenarios differ only in the macro path fed to this single model.
"""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
import core
from core import *
from features import panel, zscores, RAT, DEST, STATES

# refresh feature panel (growth features for scenarios continue the history)
P = panel(core.mh, core.sc); Z2, st2 = zscores(P); core.Z = Z2

SPEC = dict(structure='q', cols=['vix','gdp_g'], ridge=1e-4)

def main(spec=SPEC):
    R = fit(spec['cols'], structure=spec['structure'], ridge=spec['ridge'], verbose=True)
    m=R['m']; p=R['p']
    print('  a     ', np.round(R['a'],3))
    print('  c     ', np.round(R['c'],3))
    print('  delta ', np.round(R['delta'],3))
    print('  lam   ', np.round(R['lam'],3))
    # ---------- cohort ----------
    port = pd.read_csv('data/portfolio.csv')
    v0 = np.zeros(8)
    for _, r in port.iterrows(): v0[IDX[r.rating]] += r.obligors
    v0 = v0/v0.sum()
    # ---------- projections & matrices ----------
    pred_rows=[]; mat_rows=[]
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        traj, z, seq = project(R, v0, scen)
        for q in [4,9]:
            for s,val in zip(STATES, traj[q]):
                pred_rows.append(dict(scenario=scen, quarter=q, state=s, share=float(val)))
        for t in range(9):
            Mq = seq[t]
            for i,r in enumerate(RAT):
                row = dict(scenario=scen, quarter=t+1, from_rating=r)
                for j,d in enumerate(DEST): row[d]=float(Mq[i,j])
                mat_rows.append(row)
        print(f'  {scen}: z_q={np.round(z,3)}')
    # ---------- backtest: model-implied annual default rate per historical year ----------
    M,_ = annual_matrices(p, R['F'], R['Qm'], m)
    bt_rows=[]
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        for y in range(20):
            rate = float(np.dot(START[y], M[y][:7,7])/START[y].sum())
            bt_rows.append(dict(scenario=scen, year=y+1, default_rate=rate))
    pred=pd.DataFrame(pred_rows); mats=pd.DataFrame(mat_rows); bt=pd.DataFrame(bt_rows)
    pred.to_csv('predictions.csv', index=False)
    mats.to_csv('matrices.csv', index=False)
    bt.to_csv('backtest.csv', index=False)
    # ---------- checks ----------
    assert len(pred)==48 and len(mats)==189 and len(bt)==60
    s=pred.groupby(['scenario','quarter']).share.sum().values
    assert np.allclose(s,1.0), s
    assert np.allclose(mats[DEST].sum(axis=1).values,1.0)
    assert mats[DEST].values.min()>=0
    assert pred.share.min()>=0 and pred.share.max()<=1
    print('OK: predictions 48 rows, matrices 189 rows, backtest 60 rows; shares sum to 1')
    for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
        for q in [4,9]:
            v=pred[(pred.scenario==scen)&(pred.quarter==q)].set_index('state').loc[STATES,'share'].values
            print(f'   {scen:9s} q{q}: ' + ' '.join(f'{a}={b:.5f}' for a,b in zip(STATES,v)))
    return R

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
EOF

## [279] assistant

All three deliverables are written and verified. Here is what I did.

## The model (one model, estimated once on the 20-year history)

**Macro index** — I found by regression screening that the VIX level plus the GDP growth rate is by far the strongest driver of the observed transitions (the history contains three isolated macro shock quarters — q20, q53, q66 — that line up exactly with the stress years 5, 14 and 17). So each quarter gets an index `z_q = θ₁·z(VIX) + θ₂·(−z(GDP growth))`, with θ estimated jointly with the response (unit-norm constrained to kill the scale degeneracy).

**Quarterly transition matrix** (origin rating *i*, quarter *q*):
- default: `p_D(i,q) = logistic(a_i + c_i·z_q)` (rating-specific intercept and slope)
- grade migration: `P(j|i,q) ∝ exp(α_ij + [δ_i·(pos_i−pos_j) + λ_i]·z_q)` — an exponential tilt, so stress pushes mass down the rating scale and lifts the overall migration rate; the free α capture the base kernel.

**Annual matrix = product of that year's four quarterly matrices** (D absorbing), so the observed annual counts are the likelihood. Fitted by ML with analytic gradients (validated against numerical gradients), staged for stability.

## Why this structure (not an annual-level model)

Leave-one-year-out CV on the default component: **175** for the quarterly-product model with VIX+GDP, vs 299 for an annual-level model with the same index and 364 for VIX-only. A one-year-ahead reconstruction of the historical portfolio gives mean KS **0.0044** (no-migration benchmark 0.0214) and default-rate MAE 0.0013. The backtest's implied annual default rates track the observed ones with correlation 0.996 (e.g. 2020: 1.22% vs 1.16%; 2014: 9.11% vs 8.88%).

## Results (cohort from `data/portfolio.csv`, no new lending, D absorbing)

| scenario | D @ q4 | D @ q9 | BBB @ q9 | BB @ q9 | B @ q9 | CCC/C @ q9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | 1.33% | 2.73% | 0.3532 | 0.2669 | 0.1556 | 2.20% |
| adverse | 1.69% | 3.89% | 0.3444 | 0.2604 | 0.1633 | 2.49% |
| severe | 1.89% | 5.25% | 0.3360 | 0.2535 | 0.1691 | 2.81% |

Files: `predictions.csv` (48 rows, each scenario/checkpoint group sums to 1), `matrices.csv` (189 rows — the quarterly matrices actually applied, full float precision so the 1e-13 off-diagonal cells survive), `backtest.csv` (60 rows; the historical-year default rates are identical across scenarios because the model and the historical path are scenario-independent — the scenarios only change the future macro fed in).

Two implementation points worth flagging: growth features for the scenario quarters are computed on the history+scenario concatenation (otherwise the first four future quarters lose their GDP-growth information), and the three scenarios differ **only** in the macro path fed to this single estimated model — no re-estimation or overlay.

"""Leave-one-year-out CV of the FULL model, scored on the held-out year's annual matrix."""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'work')
import numpy as np, time, pickle, sys as _s
import core
from core import *
from features import panel, zscores
P = panel(core.mh, core.sc); Z2, st2 = zscores(P); core.Z = Z2

def loo(cols, split_tilt, structure='q'):
    devs=[]; kss=[]; des=[]
    t0=time.time()
    for y in range(20):
        R = fit(cols, structure=structure, split_tilt=split_tilt, held=y, verbose=False)
        devs.append(dev_year(R['M'], y))
        # portfolio reconstruction for the held-out year
        v=np.zeros(8); v[:7]=START[y]/START[y].sum()
        for q in range(4):
            mats,_ = quarterly_matrices(R['p'], R['F'], R['m'])
            break
        mats,_ = quarterly_matrices(R['p'], R['F'], R['m'])
        for q in range(4): v = v @ mats[4*y+q]
        obs = END[y]/END[y].sum()
        kss.append(np.max(np.abs(np.cumsum(v[:7])-np.cumsum(obs[:7]))))
        des.append(v[7]-obs[7])
    return devs, np.array(kss), np.array(des), time.time()-t0

if __name__=='__main__':
    for split in [False, True]:
        devs,kss,des,t = loo(['vix','gdp_g'], split)
        print(f'split_tilt={split}: LOO dev={sum(devs):.1f}  KS mean={kss.mean():.4f} max={kss.max():.4f}  D-MAE={np.abs(des).mean():.5f}  t={t:.0f}s', flush=True)
        print('   per-year dev', np.round(devs,1), flush=True)
        print('   per-year KS ', np.round(kss,4), flush=True)
        print('   per-year Derr', np.round(des,5), flush=True)
EOF
(setsid nohup python -u work/loo_full.py > work/loo_full.log 2>&1 &); sleep 250; cat work/loo_full.log
```

"""Independent end-to-end check: re-derive predictions.csv from matrices.csv alone."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
STATES=['AAA','AA','A','BBB','BB','B','CCC/C','D']
RAT=['AAA','AA','A','BBB','BB','B','CCC/C']
mats=pd.read_csv('matrices.csv'); pred=pd.read_csv('predictions.csv')
port=pd.read_csv('data/portfolio.csv')
v0=np.zeros(8)
for _,r in port.iterrows(): v0[RAT.index(r.rating)]+=r.obligors
v0/=v0.sum()
maxdiff=0.0
for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:
    sub=mats[mats.scenario==scen].sort_values(['quarter','from_rating'])
    v=v0.copy(); traj={}
    for q in range(1,10):
        M=sub[sub.quarter==q].set_index('from_rating').loc[RAT][['to_AAA','to_AA','to_A','to_BBB','to_BB','to_B','to_CCC_C','to_D']].values
        v=v@M
        if q in (4,9): traj[q]=v.copy()
    for q in (4,9):
        mine=pred[(pred.scenario==scen)&(pred.quarter==q)].set_index('state').loc[STATES,'share'].values
        maxdiff=max(maxdiff, np.abs(mine-traj[q]).max())
        assert abs(traj[q].sum()-1)<1e-12
print('max |predictions.csv - projection rebuilt from matrices.csv| = %.3e' % maxdiff)
assert maxdiff < 1e-12
# D must be absorbing & cumulative
for scen in ['baseline','adverse','severe']:

    v=v0.copy(); ds=[]

        M=sub[sub.quarter==q].set_index('from_rating').loc[RAT][['to_AAA','to_AA','to_A','to_BBB','to_BB','to_B','to_CCC_C','to_D']].values
        v=v@M; ds.append(v[7])
    ds=np.array(ds)
    assert np.all(np.diff(ds)>=-1e-15), (scen, ds)

print('END-TO-END CONSISTENCY VERIFIED')
